title: Daily Sales Report Automation for Multi-Store Retailers
description: Daily sales report automation brings every store's figures into one morning summary and flags what needs attention. A guide for multi-store retailers.
author: Yogansh Banthia

hero.alt: Daily sales report automation: a laptop showing one dashboard for every store

faq_heading: Questions owners ask about daily sales report automation

faqs.q: How much does daily sales report automation cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on the number of stores, the systems it connects to and the measures you want. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to set up?
faqs.a: Setup depends on the number of sources, the quality of the data and how quickly your team agrees the measures. Clara AI delivers a first demo within 7 days of receiving your material and confirms the full timeline after diagnosis.

faqs.q: Does it work if some stores still use spreadsheets?
faqs.a: Yes. Spreadsheets can be read like any other source. They are cleaned and matched, and over time you can move those stores onto a till system if you wish.

faqs.q: Can the summary be sent on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. It can go by email, WhatsApp or both. On WhatsApp, a daily message is sent as a pre-approved template, because a business can reply freely only within 24 hours of the person's last message.

faqs.q: Do we need a data team?
faqs.a: No. Clara AI builds, deploys and manages the system, and your team reviews the figures and decides what to do.
